messages.subject: For Mariette Steyn | Social performance, host-community value and 2035 execution
messages.body:
Dear Gold Fields Sustainability Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Ms. Mariette Steyn, Executive Vice President, People and Sustainability.

Gold Fields' 2035 commitments place host-community value, social performance, responsible environmental stewardship and portfolio growth inside one operating agenda. The company's current focus on shared value, renewable energy and stronger social and human-rights systems makes disciplined asset-level execution especially important.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, community engagement, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional commitment management. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and I coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would value a conversation about where this experience might support Gold Fields' people and sustainability agenda, particularly across social performance, host-community value, stakeholder governance or regional leadership. My attached CV is tailored specifically to those priorities.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
